targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  destination_table.dataset_id,
  destination_table.table_id,
  sum(total_bytes_processed / 1000000000000)*6.75 as cost_usd,
  AVG(SAFE_DIVIDE(total_slot_ms,(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(end_time, start_time, MILLISECOND)))) AS avg_slots,
  MIN(SAFE_DIVIDE(total_slot_ms,(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(end_time, start_time, MILLISECOND)))) AS min_slots,
  MAX(SAFE_DIVIDE(total_slot_ms,(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(end_time, start_time, MILLISECOND)))) AS max_slots
  FROM
  `region-asia-southeast1`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_PROJECT jbo
  WHERE $__timeFilter(creation_time) and user_email = "tf-data-transfer-bq@ridebeam-data.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  and destination_table.table_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1,2
  ORDER BY
     cost_usd DESC
